neighbours.label: the width / zero-padding digits right after '%' in a printf-style format string ('%02d', '%03d')
quiet: The shop took 15% off the price and then another 5% at the till.
The crate held 24 jars: 10 of honey and 14 of jam.

notes: Card: peaks on digits, ' %' and '=%'; the code example is '%02d'. Probes: format strings 0.19-0.31; years and counts in prose 0.00-0.04 except '2030 ... 2045' 0.20. Weak and not well pinned down: the top example ('37 genes: 13') is not explained by this label. The - pole is a much stronger digit unit (212°F, 802.11, 1492: the digit before a final 2).
